knowledge.name: Facility and SKU Snapshot
knowledge.detail: Fixed synthetic records for four warehouses, six SKUs, capacity, on-hand quantities, unit values, weights, and reorder points.

knowledge.name: Forecast, Cost, and Review Rules
knowledge.detail: Synthetic demand forecasts, portfolio classes, holding rates, transfer lanes, tolerances, and authorization boundaries.

intelligence_processing.name: Capacity and Reorder Exposure
intelligence_processing.detail: Calculates facility utilization, inventory value, and SKU positions below fixed reorder points from the approved snapshot.

intelligence_processing.name: Forecast Imbalance Classification
intelligence_processing.detail: Compares on-hand stock with forecasts and labels material surplus, deficit, velocity, strategic value, and lifecycle risk.

intelligence_processing.name: Proposed Transfer Planning
intelligence_processing.detail: Pairs synthetic surplus and deficit positions into review-ready warehouse moves with quantities, lanes, weights, and estimated cost.

intelligence_processing.name: Inventory Cost Trade-offs
intelligence_processing.detail: Compares holding cost, reorder shortfall value, and proposed transfer estimates for a human planning discussion.

clients_user_interface.name: Copilot Studio Conversation
clients_user_interface.detail: Routes persona-language requests to four governed skills for snapshot, imbalance, transfer-plan, and cost-analysis responses.

clients_user_interface.name: Microsoft 365 Copilot Entry
clients_user_interface.detail: Provides a conversational entry point for supply chain, inventory, procurement, and warehouse planning personas.

clients_user_interface.name: Review-Ready Evidence Views
clients_user_interface.detail: Presents facility, SKU, transfer, and cost evidence in concise tables while separating facts from recommendations.

management_reporting.name: Capacity and Inventory Review
management_reporting.detail: Reports utilization, pallets, inventory value, reorder exposure, and the synthetic identifiers supporting each finding.

management_reporting.name: Imbalance and Lifecycle Review
management_reporting.detail: Summarizes forecast-relative shortages, excess, slow-moving classifications, and lifecycle flags without declaring obsolescence.

management_reporting.name: Planner Transfer and Cost Pack
management_reporting.detail: Packages proposed moves and synthetic cost trade-offs for authorized planner review; no inventory movement is performed.

tools.name: InventoryRebalancingAgent
tools.detail: Portable Brainstem tool exposing deterministic snapshot, recommendation, proposed transfer, and cost-analysis operations.

tools.name: Copilot Studio Operation Skills
tools.detail: Four inline skills route persona requests and enforce synthetic evidence, review language, and no-side-effect boundaries.

tools.name: Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management
tools.detail: Approved production inventory, demand, and policy source to bind through a dedicated connection reference.

tools.name: Warehouse and Transportation Systems
tools.detail: Approved WMS and transportation sources for validated planning data and separately authorized execution.

tools.name: Power BI
tools.detail: Planned reporting surface for portfolio, facility-capacity, inventory-exposure, and planning-review views.

tools.name: Microsoft Teams
tools.detail: Planned collaboration surface for inventory, warehouse, transportation, procurement, and finance review.

supporting_features.name: Claude Sonnet 4.6
supporting_features.detail: Validated Copilot Studio authoring model for the current draft pilot package.

supporting_features.name: Fixed Synthetic Evidence
supporting_features.detail: Every warehouse, SKU, quantity, classification, duration, and cost is labeled as fictional pilot evidence.

supporting_features.name: Human Authorization Gate
supporting_features.detail: Inventory and warehouse owners must review proposals before any reservation, transfer, reorder, return, or policy change.

supporting_features.name: No Inventory Side Effects
supporting_features.detail: The solution does not reserve, pick, ship, move, reorder, return, liquidate, or change inventory policy.

supporting_features.name: Deterministic Case Evidence
supporting_features.detail: Four persona-language cases verify routing, expected records, cost framing, and recommendation-only behavior.

supporting_features.name: Draft and Unpublished State
supporting_features.detail: The exported unmanaged Copilot Studio solution remains draft and requires explicit administrator review before publication.
